$comment: The crosswalk as reviewers who teach to this curriculum wrote it, point by point, from the official text (scripts/curricula/apply-review.js --authored). `why` is the reviewer's reason; the registry's builder adds each row's grade and writes crosswalk.json.

K:position-words.why: MAT.3.7 asks to communicate position 'usando termini adeguati (sopra/sotto, davanti/dietro, destra/sinistra, dentro/fuori)' and GEO.3.1 names the 'indicatori topologici'; an infanzia sheet can only prepare both.

K:scene-search.why: Only the shape part fits: finding the shape of everyday objects is a first step to 'Riconoscere ... figure geometriche'. The pure picture search has no objective.

K:compare-size-extremes.why: Direct comparison of length and height is the step before 'Misurare grandezze (lunghezze, ...)' with arbitrary units.

K:order-by-size.why: SCI.3.2 says 'Seriare e classificare oggetti in base alle loro proprietà'; seriating pictures by size is the readiness form, and it precedes measuring lengths (MAT.3.14).

K:patterns.why: The only objective on patterns is 'Riconoscere e descrivere regolarità in una sequenza di numeri o di figure' (end of classe quinta); no classe-terza objective names regolarità.

K:one-to-one.why: One-to-one correspondence is the idea under 'Contare oggetti o eventi'.

K:compare-groups.why: More / fewer / equal between two groups prepares 'confrontarli e ordinarli' of MAT.3.2 and rests on counting objects (MAT.3.1).

K:count-how-many.why: 'Contare oggetti' and 'Leggere e scrivere i numeri naturali', here only to 10-20 and before school.

K:subitize.why: Seeing small quantities at a glance supports 'Contare oggetti ... a voce e mentalmente'.

K:conservation.why: Conservation of quantity is a prerequisite of counting objects; no objective states it.

K:count-out-n.why: Making a set of N is counting objects in the other direction ('Contare oggetti').

K:shape-naming.why: 'Riconoscere, denominare e descrivere figure geometriche', at infanzia level.

K:numeral-formation.why: Writing the digits prepares 'Leggere e scrivere i numeri naturali in notazione decimale'; the tracing is the 'capacità manuali ... necessarie per l'apprendimento della scrittura'.

K:colour-by-number.why: The child must read numerals to follow the key: a step toward 'Leggere ... i numeri naturali'.

K:classify-count-kinds.why: 'Classificare ... oggetti in base a una o più proprietà' and then 'Contare oggetti'.

K:count-sides.why: Counting sides is a first way to 'descrivere figure geometriche'; sorting by number of sides is 'Classificare ... figure ... in base a una ... proprietà'.

K:count-forward-missing.why: Counting 'in senso progressivo' and writing the numbers in order, to 20 only.

K:dot-to-dot-sequence.why: Following the counting order ('in senso progressivo') while reading the numerals to 30.

K:one-more-one-less.why: Each next number is one more: counting forward and backward, and the idea before 'semplici operazioni' (+1, -1).

K:before-after-back.why: 'in senso progressivo e regressivo' (count back from 10) and ordering numbers ('ordinarli').

K:ordinal-position.why: No objective names ordinal numbers; finding the Nth in a line is counting objects from a given end ('Contare oggetti o eventi').

K:days-of-week.why: The week is one of the 'cicli temporali' with its 'relazioni di successione' (STO.3.4) and the base of the calendar (STO.3.5); in Italy this is storia, not matematica.

K:tally-marks.why: A tally is a first way to 'rappresentare ... dati' and to record a count.

K:estimate.why: Estimating a quantity and checking by counting supports 'Contare oggetti'; the objectives on estimating (MAT.3.6 distances and volumes, MAT.5.4 result of an operation) are about other things.

K:heavy-light.why: Comparing weights directly comes before 'Misurare grandezze'; weight is one of the 'proprietà' by which SCI.3.2 has objects seriated.

K:draw-shapes.why: 'Disegnare figure geometriche', here on dot paper at infanzia level.

K:combine-groups.why: Putting two groups together and counting all is addition before its formal form ('semplici operazioni con i numeri naturali').

K:take-away.why: Crossing out and counting what is left is subtraction before its formal form.

K:count-on.why: Counting on from a known number is counting 'in senso progressivo' used as the first addition strategy.

K:number-bonds-k.why: Decomposing numbers to 10 (gli amici del 10) is the base of 'Eseguire mentalmente semplici operazioni'.

K:compose-shapes.why: Tangram figures prepare 'costruire modelli materiali' and recognising figures inside a figure.

K:mirror-image.why: 'Riconoscere figure ruotate, traslate e riflesse' is asked only by the end of classe quinta; no classe-terza objective names reflection.

K:odd-even-pairing.why: Pari / dispari is a way to 'Classificare numeri ... in base a una ... proprietà'; here by pairing objects.

K:teen-numbers.why: Ten and some more ones is the first 'consapevolezza della notazione posizionale'.

K:fact-fluency-colour-code.why: 'Eseguire mentalmente semplici operazioni con i numeri naturali'; a year-K sheet can only prepare it (within 20 this is classe prima work in Italy).

K:number-bonds-20.why: Bonds to 20 feed mental calculation (MAT.3.3); in Italy this is classe prima content.

1:add-within-10-models.why: Addition within 10-12 is among the 'semplici operazioni con i numeri naturali'; the models are counted ('Contare oggetti'). The wording gives no number range; judged by classe prima.

1:subtract-cross-out.why: Subtraction within 10 is a 'semplice operazione'; the picture model is the classe prima way to it.

1:write-the-equation.why: Writing the whole addition or subtraction for a situation is doing and stating a 'semplice operazione' ('verbalizzare le procedure di calcolo' in written form).

1:patterns-missing.why: 'Riconoscere e descrivere regolarità in una sequenza ... di figure' is a classe-quinta objective; a repeating picture pattern is its early form.

1:sort-three-groups.why: 'Classificare ... oggetti in base a una o più proprietà'.

1:make-10.why: Bonds to 10 are the core of mental calculation in classe prima ('Eseguire mentalmente semplici operazioni').

1:shape-attributes.why: 'Riconoscere, denominare e descrivere figure geometriche': naming, telling by attributes, riddles that describe.

1:ordinal-numbers.why: The Indicazioni name no objective on ordinal numbers; the nearest is counting objects or events in order ('Contare oggetti o eventi'). Writing ordinal words is beyond the wording.

1:number-line-placement.why: MAT.3.2: 'confrontarli e ordinarli, anche rappresentandoli sulla retta'.

1:count-on-back-hops.why: Counting 'in senso progressivo e regressivo' on the line, used to add and subtract.

1:word-problems.why: The classe-terza objectives hold no line on problems (problem solving is in the traguardi, not in this registry); the operation done is a 'semplice operazione' within 20.

1:picture-graphs-sort-count.why: 'Leggere e rappresentare relazioni e dati con diagrammi, schemi e tabelle' after a classification (MAT.3.11).

1:doubles-halves.why: Il doppio e la metà to 20 are mental 'semplici operazioni'.

1:odd-even-pairs.why: Pari e dispari: 'Classificare numeri ... in base a una ... proprietà'.

1:near-doubles.why: A mental strategy made explicit: 'Eseguire mentalmente semplici operazioni ... e verbalizzare le procedure di calcolo'.

1:add-three-addends.why: Adding three small numbers is a 'semplice operazione' done mentally.

1:fact-families.why: Addition and subtraction as inverse operations on three numbers: part of doing and explaining simple operations (MAT.3.3).

1:missing-number-equations.why: Finding the missing term within 10/20 is mental calculation with natural numbers.

1:true-false-equations.why: Judging an equality needs the operations on both sides done mentally (MAT.3.3); the meaning of the equal sign has no objective of its own.

1:bar-model.why: The bar is a 'schema' that represents a relation between numbers ('Leggere e rappresentare relazioni ... con diagrammi, schemi'); the missing part is found by a simple operation.

1:tangram-compose.why: Recognising the pieces inside a figure is 'Riconoscere ... figure geometriche'; on paper it only prepares 'costruire modelli materiali'.

1:days-months-seasons.why: 'relazioni di successione ... cicli temporali' (days, months, seasons) and the calendar among the 'strumenti convenzionali per la misurazione e la rappresentazione del tempo'. Storia in Italy, not matematica.

1:days-months-seasons~season-wheel.why: As the parent point; the season wheel also meets 'la periodicità dei fenomeni celesti (dì/notte, percorsi del sole, stagioni)'.

1:measure-length-units.why: 'Misurare grandezze (lunghezze, ...) utilizzando sia unità arbitrarie ...': unit cubes are the arbitrary unit.

1:time-read.why: MAT.3.14 names 'tempo' and 'orologio'; STO.3.5 asks 'la funzione e l'uso degli strumenti convenzionali per la misurazione ... del tempo (orologio, ...)'.

1:fluency-within-20.why: 'Eseguire mentalmente semplici operazioni con i numeri naturali e verbalizzare le procedure di calcolo' (the make-a-ten strategy).

1:number-walls.why: Sums and differences done mentally in a puzzle frame.

1:check-answers.why: Checking a calculation means redoing the simple operation mentally.

1:bar-graphs.why: 'Leggere e rappresentare relazioni e dati con diagrammi, schemi e tabelle'.

1:tens-and-ones.why: Decine e unità: 'avendo consapevolezza della notazione posizionale'.

1:number-words.why: 'Leggere e scrivere i numeri naturali', in digits and in words.

1:hundreds-chart.why: The structure of the chart is the positional notation to 100; counting patterns are counting 'per salti'.

1:one-ten-more-less.why: +1, -1, +10, -10 are mental operations that rest on tens and ones.

1:number-of-the-day.why: One number read, written and decomposed many ways: 'Leggere e scrivere i numeri naturali in notazione decimale, avendo consapevolezza della notazione posizionale'.

1:time-set-hands.why: Use of the clock ('orologio' in both MAT.3.14 and STO.3.5). Five-minute times are classe seconda work in Italy; the wording sets no step.

1:coins.why: Adding coin values is a simple operation; MAT.3.5 uses coins for decimal numbers ('anche con riferimento alle monete'), which whole-value purses only prepare. Skill line gives no values; judged by classe prima.

1:open-number-line.why: The drawn jumps are the written trace of 'verbalizzare le procedure di calcolo' for a mental operation.

1:mental-math-to-100.why: 'Eseguire mentalmente semplici operazioni con i numeri naturali', without columns.

1:bonds-to-100.why: Complements to 100 are mental calculation (MAT.3.3); in Italy usually classe seconda.

2:bundle-ten-ones.why: Il cambio: ten ones for one ten is the 'consapevolezza della notazione posizionale'.

2:hundreds-chart-moves.why: Moves of +1 and +10 on the chart: positional notation and mental addition.

2:odd-even.why: 'Classificare numeri ... in base a una o più proprietà' (pari / dispari, also by the ones digit).

2:2d-attributes.why: 'Classificare ... figure ... in base a una ... proprietà' (number of sides), which also describes the figures.

2:add-sub-within-100-practice.why: Addition and subtraction within 100 done mentally in puzzle formats.

2:two-step-word-problems.why: No classe-terza objective is about problems (they are in the traguardi); the calculation within 100 is MAT.3.3.

2:measure-with-ruler.why: 'Misurare grandezze (lunghezze ...) utilizzando ... unità e strumenti convenzionali (metro ...)'.

2:compare-lengths.why: Two measures with the ruler and their difference: measuring lengths with conventional units.

2:read-build-3-digit.why: Centinaia, decine, unità: reading and writing numbers with positional awareness. The wording sets no range; to 1000 is classe terza in most Italian schools.

2:expanded-form-digit-value.why: The value of a digit is exactly the 'consapevolezza della notazione posizionale'.

2:chart-within-1000.why: Counting forward within 1000 and reading the numbers by place.

2:hundred-more-less.why: +100 / -100 as a mental operation on the hundreds place.

2:time-5-min-quarter.why: Reading the clock: 'orologio' in MAT.3.14 and STO.3.5.

2:calendar.why: STO.3.5 names the 'calendario' among the instruments to measure and represent time; days between two dates is measuring 'tempo' (MAT.3.14).

2:flat-or-solid.why: Recognising figures and classifying them by a property (piane / solide).

2:solids-in-real-life.why: 'Riconoscere, denominare ... figure geometriche', here the solids in objects.

2:3d-faces-edges-vertices.why: Facce, spigoli e vertici are how a solid is described ('descrivere figure geometriche').

2:add-with-blocks.why: Adding with base-ten blocks works on place value and is the step before 'gli algoritmi scritti usuali'.

2:subtract-with-blocks.why: As for addition: the block model precedes the written algorithm of MAT.3.4.

2:column-method.why: 'Eseguire le operazioni con i numeri naturali con gli algoritmi scritti usuali' (addizione e sottrazione in colonna con riporto e prestito).

2:shopping-money.why: The skill line gives no prices; in classe seconda they are whole euros or cents, so the sums are MAT.3.3 and they prepare 'semplici addizioni e sottrazioni, anche con riferimento alle monete' with decimals. With prices such as 2,50 € it would teach MAT.3.5.

2:bar-graphs.why: 'Leggere e rappresentare relazioni e dati con diagrammi, schemi e tabelle'.

2:line-plots.why: A line plot is a diagram of data to read (MAT.3.13); the format itself is not usual in Italian books.

2:round-to-ten.why: No objective names rounding. On the number line the child compares a number with the two tens ('confrontarli ... anche rappresentandoli sulla retta'); rounding serves 'Stimare il risultato di una operazione' (classe quinta).

2:mass-grams.why: MAT.3.14: 'Misurare grandezze (lunghezze, tempo, ecc.) utilizzando ... unità e strumenti convenzionali'; mass is named only in MAT.5.24 ('masse, pesi').

2:read-jugs.why: Capacity with a conventional unit falls under the 'ecc.' of MAT.3.14; 'volumi/capacità' are named in MAT.5.24 and reading a jug is using 'scale graduate' (MAT.5.8).

2:choose-units.why: SCI.3.3 says it word for word: 'Individuare strumenti e unità di misura appropriati alle situazioni'. Inches and feet do not exist in the Italian version.

2:equal-groups-times.why: Multiplication as repeated addition is a 'semplice operazione'; it comes before 'Conoscere con sicurezza le tabelline'.

2:arrays.why: Gli schieramenti: the meaning of multiplication, before the tables are known by heart.

2:skip-count-3-4.why: 'per salti di due, tre, ...' and the numerazioni that become the tabelline.

2:scaled-pictograph.why: Reading and making an ideogramma: 'Leggere e rappresentare ... dati con diagrammi'.

2:share-and-group.why: Sharing and grouping without the division sign is the idea before division as a 'semplice operazione'.

2:equal-shares-shapes.why: The 2012 objectives name fractions only for the end of classe quinta ('Operare con le frazioni e riconoscere frazioni equivalenti'); the classe-terza list has none.

2:fraction-of-a-set.why: A unit fraction of a set is the first step of 'Operare con le frazioni' (classe quinta); nothing in the classe-terza list.

2:symmetry-line.why: Symmetry is named only in MAT.5.10 ('identificando elementi significativi e simmetrie'); deciding whether a line is a mirror line is its first step.

2:symmetry-complete.why: Drawing the reflected half prepares 'Riconoscere figure ... riflesse' and the 'simmetrie' of MAT.5.10; both classe quinta.

2:grid-coordinates.why: Letter-number squares (as in battaglia navale) come before 'Utilizzare il piano cartesiano per localizzare punti'.

2:tangram-orientation.why: The child must tell the identical figure from turned and flipped ones: 'Riconoscere figure ruotate, traslate e riflesse', asked only by the end of classe quinta.

3:compare-4-digit.why: 'confrontarli e ordinarli' with 'consapevolezza della notazione posizionale'; the wording sets no range and classe terza works to the thousands.

3:rounding.why: No objective names rounding: the number-line work is MAT.3.2 ('rappresentandoli sulla retta'), the purpose is 'Stimare il risultato di una operazione' (classe quinta).

3:column-regrouping.why: 'Eseguire le operazioni con i numeri naturali con gli algoritmi scritti usuali'.

3:estimate-by-rounding.why: 'Stimare il risultato di una operazione': the demand is met, though the objective is placed at the end of classe quinta.

3:magic-squares.why: Sums and missing addends done mentally.

3:parity-of-sums.why: Goes beyond 'Classificare numeri ... in base a una ... proprietà': the child reasons on the parity of a sum without calculating.

3:arithmetic-patterns.why: 'Riconoscere e descrivere regolarità in una sequenza di numeri' (classe quinta, demand met) and counting forward and back 'per salti'.

3:time-to-minute.why: Measuring time with the clock (MAT.3.14) and its use (STO.3.5).

3:mult-equal-groups.why: The meaning of a product (groups, array) is a simple operation understood; it supports 'le tabelline'.

3:mult-number-line.why: Equal jumps from 0 are counting 'per salti di due, tre, ...'; the numbers reached are the multiples of 'individuare multipli e divisori di un numero'.

3:commutative.why: The commutative property is used and stated in mental calculation ('verbalizzare le procedure di calcolo') and halves the tables to learn.

3:times-tables.why: 'Conoscere con sicurezza le tabelline della moltiplicazione dei numeri fino a 10'.

3:scaled-graphs.why: 'Leggere e rappresentare relazioni e dati con diagrammi, schemi e tabelle', with a scale.

3:thermometer.why: Temperature read on a conventional instrument (the 'ecc.' of MAT.3.14); 'utilizzare scale graduate in contesti significativi per le scienze' is MAT.5.8.

3:division-sharing.why: Division as sharing (ripartizione) is one of the 'semplici operazioni con i numeri naturali' of classe terza.

3:division-repeated-subtraction.why: Division as grouping (contenenza), done by counting back 'in senso ... regressivo e per salti'.

3:mult-div-relationship.why: Division as the inverse of multiplication, solved through the tables ('le tabelline ... fino a 10').

3:muldiv-word-problems.why: No objective on problems in the classe-terza list (traguardi only); the multiplications and divisions use the tables.

3:input-output.why: The machine with its table is a relation read and represented ('Leggere e rappresentare relazioni ... con ... tabelle'); the rule is applied mentally.

3:balance-equations.why: Equalities with an operation on both sides are solved by mental calculation; the objectives do not name equality as such.

3:add-subtract-time.why: Calculating with clock times goes beyond measuring time with the clock (MAT.3.14) toward 'intervalli temporali' of MAT.5.24.

3:elapsed-duration.why: Finding how long between two clock times is measuring 'tempo' with the 'orologio' (MAT.3.14); 'intervalli temporali' is named in MAT.5.24.

3:time-12-24.why: 'la funzione e l'uso degli strumenti convenzionali per la misurazione ... del tempo (orologio ...)'; the 24-hour form is the everyday written form in Italy.

3:area-model.why: Counting unit squares measures a grandezza with an arbitrary unit (MAT.3.14); 'Determinare l'area di rettangoli' is asked by the end of classe quinta.

3:same-area.why: Area in unit squares compared across shapes (figure equiestese): before MAT.5.19.

3:perimeter.why: 'Determinare il perimetro di una figura utilizzando le più comuni formule o altri procedimenti': adding the sides is one of the 'altri procedimenti'. Placed at the end of classe quinta.

3:same-perimeter.why: Perimeter is found (MAT.5.18) and set against area counted in squares (before MAT.5.19): isoperimetria ed equiestensione.

3:division-remainder.why: 'Eseguire la divisione con resto fra numeri naturali' is a classe-quinta objective; within the tables it is a simple operation of classe terza.

3:right-angles.why: Angles appear only in classe quinta ('Confrontare e misurare angoli'; 'perpendicolarità'); comparing with a square corner is the first step.

3:classify-quadrilaterals.why: Naming and describing figures and 'Classificare ... figure ... in base a una o più proprietà'; the inclusive classification (a square is a rectangle) points to MAT.5.10.

3:symmetry.why: MAT.5.10: 'identificando elementi significativi e simmetrie' - a clearly stated part, asked by the end of classe quinta.

3:partition-equal-areas.why: Unit fractions of a shape: fractions are named only in the classe-quinta objectives ('Operare con le frazioni').

3:fraction-unit-build.why: a/b as a copies of 1/b is the concept before 'Operare con le frazioni'.

3:whole-from-unit.why: From the unit fraction to the whole: fraction concept before MAT.5.5.

3:fraction-number-line.why: 'Rappresentare i numeri conosciuti sulla retta' (classe quinta), here fractions between 0 and 1.

3:compare-fractions.why: Comparing fractions with pictures is a first way of working with fractions (MAT.5.5).

3:equivalent-fractions.why: 'riconoscere frazioni equivalenti' is in MAT.5.5; with picture models in classe terza it is its first step.

3:fraction-of-set.why: The fraction as operator on a quantity (1/3 of 12) belongs to 'Operare con le frazioni'.

3:line-plot-halves.why: Measuring lengths and representing the data in a diagram. Italian schools would measure in cm and mm (decimals), not in half units.

3:volume-cubes.why: Unit cubes are an arbitrary unit for a grandezza (MAT.3.14); 'volumi' are named in MAT.5.24, and seeing hidden cubes in a drawing is 'Riconoscere rappresentazioni piane di oggetti tridimensionali'.

K:pre-writing-strokes.why: Pregrafismo: 'Acquisire le capacità manuali, percettive e cognitive necessarie per l'apprendimento della scrittura'.

K:all-about-me-personal.why: A self-portrait and drawings of what I like are early 'produzioni personali ... per esprimere sensazioni ed emozioni; rappresentare ... la realtà percepita'.

K:rhyme.why: No objective names rhyme; hearing rhymes belongs to the 'capacità ... percettive e cognitive necessarie per l'apprendimento della scrittura' (phonological awareness).

K:category-sort.why: 'Classificare ... oggetti in base a una o più proprietà'.

K:letter-identification.why: Telling b / d / p / q apart is perceptual readiness for writing and for 'la lettura strumentale (di decifrazione)'.

K:letter-formation.why: Tracing letters builds the 'capacità manuali ... necessarie per l'apprendimento della scrittura'.

K:count-syllables.why: The syllable is the unit Italian children learn to read and write with; counting syllables is readiness for both.

K:letter-case.why: Matching maiuscolo and minuscolo is letter knowledge before decoding.

K:beginning-sounds.why: The first sound and its letter (corrispondenza suono-segno) come before reading and writing words.

K:category-odd-one-out.why: Finding the intruder is classification by a property.

K:opposites.why: Picture opposites widen vocabulary ('Ampliare il patrimonio lessicale'); meaning relations between words are named only in the classe-quinta objectives.

K:alphabet-order.why: Knowing the letters prepares decoding; alphabetical order has no objective of its own and serves 'Utilizzare il dizionario' (classe quinta).

K:story-sequencing.why: Ordering story pictures prepares telling 'rispettando l'ordine cronologico' and 'relazioni di successione' (prima, dopo, infine).

K:sound-position.why: Hearing where a sound sits in a word is phonological readiness for writing and decoding.

K:vowels-consonants.why: Vocali e consonanti is the first letter knowledge of classe prima, before syllables are read.

K:bilingual-cards.why: Picture word cards widen vocabulary; the second-language side would belong to the lingua inglese objectives, which this registry does not hold.

K:segment-phonemes.why: Analysing a word into sounds is the cognitive base of writing; two letters for one sound (ch, gh, gn, gl, sc) is the start of 'attenzione alla grafia delle parole'.

K:cvc-build.why: Building first words from letters prepares reading and writing. Italian has almost no CVC words; the Italian sheets must use two-syllable words (mela, sole).

K:word-picture-match.why: Reading a word and linking it to its picture is the first 'lettura strumentale'.

K:singular-plural.why: Number of the noun is one of the 'principali tratti grammaticali' of ITA.5.36; no classe-terza objective names it.

K:digraphs-k.why: English sh / ch have Italian counterparts in the digrammi (sc, gn, gl, ch, gh): hearing them prepares writing and later orthography.

K:sight-words-reading.why: Reading very frequent words at sight supports 'la lettura strumentale'; sight-word teaching is an English method (Italian spelling is regular), so the fit is loose.

K:word-sentence-tracing.why: Tracing and copying words left to right with spaces: 'capacità manuali, percettive e cognitive necessarie per l'apprendimento della scrittura'.

K:articles.why: The article (il / lo / la, un / uno / una) is a part of speech; 'Riconoscere ... le parti del discorso' is stated only for the end of classe quinta.

1:rhyming.why: Rhyme work trains the perceptual and cognitive abilities needed for writing (ITA.3.13); producing rhymes prepares 'testi creativi sulla base di modelli dati (filastrocche ...)'.

1:phoneme-boxes.why: Segmenting is the cognitive ability under writing; blending is the step into 'lettura ... di decifrazione'.

1:digraphs.why: In Italian these are the digrammi and trigrammi (ch, gh, gn, gl, sc): 'Prestare attenzione alla grafia delle parole' and reading them correctly. English th has no counterpart.

1:spell-picture-words.why: Writing words correctly from a picture (autodettato) applies 'le conoscenze ortografiche' and prepares 'Scrivere sotto dettatura curando ... l'ortografia'.

1:syllables-split.why: Syllables are the core of learning to write in Italian (ITA.3.13); dividing a word into syllables is also an orthographic convention (andare a capo).

1:syllable-vowel.why: Knowing that each syllable holds a vowel is part of the cognitive base of syllabic writing.

1:word-families-syllable-reading.why: 'Padroneggiare la lettura strumentale (di decifrazione)': joining syllables, reading words with consonant groups.

1:alphabetical-order.why: Alphabetical order is needed for 'Utilizzare il dizionario come strumento di consultazione' (classe quinta); the classe-terza list has nothing on it.

1:opposites.why: Choosing the opposite for a sentence is 'Usare in modo appropriato le parole'; opposites as a meaning relation ('somiglianze, differenze') are in ITA.5.34.

1:articles.why: Sorting nouns by article works on gender and number, 'i principali tratti grammaticali' of ITA.5.36; Italian schools do this in classe prima and seconda although the objective is written for classe quinta.

1:read-and-follow.why: Silent reading to do something: 'Comprendere testi di tipo diverso ... in vista di scopi pratici'; 'Seguire istruzioni scritte' is the classe-quinta form.

1:cloze.why: The right word for the sentence ('Usare in modo appropriato le parole man mano apprese') after reading it.

1:synonyms.why: Two words for one picture widens vocabulary through reading (ITA.3.18); synonymy as a relation ('somiglianze') is ITA.5.34.

1:unscramble-sentence.why: 'frasi semplici e compiute ... che rispettino le convenzioni ortografiche e di interpunzione' (capital, end mark); it prepares judging whether a sentence is complete.

1:question-words.why: Chi / che cosa / dove on single sentences prepares finding 'le informazioni principali' in a text and the 'elementi essenziali' of a sentence.

1:story-sequencing.why: Ordering sentences to pictures finds the information 'e le loro relazioni'; 'relazioni di successione ... in ... esperienze vissute e narrate'; it prepares oral telling in chronological order.

1:word-classes.why: 'Riconoscere ... le parti del discorso' is stated only for the end of classe quinta; nomi, verbi, aggettivi sorted in classe prima are its start.

1:pronouns.why: Personal pronouns are a part of speech (ITA.5.36). In Italian the sort is lui / lei / loro.

1:shades-of-meaning.why: Ordering near-synonyms by strength works on 'relazioni di significato tra le parole (somiglianze, differenze ...)'.

1:root-words.why: ITA.3.17 names 'la conoscenza intuitiva delle famiglie di parole'; derivation as a mechanism is ITA.5.33.

1:story-writing.why: 'Produrre semplici testi funzionali, narrativi e descrittivi legati a scopi concreti' (story, description, postcard); the story map prepares 'pianificare la traccia di un racconto'.

2:digraphs.why: 'Prestare attenzione alla grafia delle parole nei testi': finding a digramma (sc, gn, gl, ch, gh) in sentences.

2:sentence-boundaries.why: 'convenzioni ortografiche e di interpunzione' (capital, full stop, question mark) and 'Riconoscere se una frase è o no completa' when two sentences are split.

2:cursive-writing.why: 'Acquisire le capacità manuali ... necessarie per l'apprendimento della scrittura'. In Italy corsivo is taught in classe prima.

2:cloze-context.why: Reading a text for its information and relations, then using the fitting word; relying on context prepares 'basandosi ... sul contesto' for unknown words.

2:question-words.why: The question word that asks for a part of the sentence (chi, dove, perché, come) leads to its 'elementi essenziali (soggetto, verbo, complementi necessari)' and to questions on a text.

2:read-and-answer.why: 'Leggere testi (narrativi ...) cogliendo l'argomento ... e individuando le informazioni principali e le loro relazioni'; a short story read for its sense.

2:describe-a-picture.why: Simple 'testi ... descrittivi' made of 'frasi semplici e compiute'.

2:word-classes.why: Sorting isolated words into nomi, verbi, aggettivi comes before 'Riconoscere in una frase o in un testo le parti del discorso' (classe quinta).

2:plural-nouns.why: Writing Italian plurals is orthography (-chi / -ghi, -cie / -gie, uomo-uomini): 'applicare le conoscenze ortografiche'; number as a grammatical trait is ITA.5.36.

2:spelling-rules.why: The English rules named have no Italian counterpart; the Italian position rules (c / g dolce e dura with h, cu / qu / cqu, mb / mp, plurals in -cie / -gie) are 'conoscenze ortografiche' and prepare dictation.

2:synonyms.why: Choosing a more exact word for 'dire' is 'Usare in modo appropriato le parole'; synonymy as a relation is ITA.5.34.

2:verb-forms.why: Tense is a grammatical trait of the verb (ITA.5.36, classe quinta); finding the verb prepares the 'elementi essenziali (soggetto, verbo ...)' of ITA.3.22. In Italian: essere, avere, fare, andare, presente and passato prossimo / imperfetto.

2:pronouns.why: Personal and possessive pronouns are parts of speech (ITA.5.36).

2:read-cursive.why: 'Padroneggiare la lettura strumentale (di decifrazione)' includes reading every script, corsivo too.

2:compound-words.why: 'Conoscere i principali meccanismi di formazione delle parole (parole semplici, derivate, composte)' is a classe-quinta objective. Italian compounds have no joining letter (portacenere, pescespada).

2:root-words.why: 'conoscenza intuitiva delle famiglie di parole' (ITA.3.17); the formal view of derived words is ITA.5.33.

2:prefixes.why: A prefixed word understood from its family (felice / infelice, fare / rifare) fits ITA.3.17; prefixation as a mechanism is 'parole ... derivate' in ITA.5.33.

2:retell-with-starters.why: A short written 'testo ... narrativo' in complete sentences; the time-order starters also train 'rispettando l'ordine cronologico' for oral telling.

2:mystery-animal.why: The clues are a short text read 'individuando le informazioni principali e le loro relazioni'.

2:animal-fact-file.why: 'Leggere semplici testi di divulgazione per ricavarne informazioni' and write them in a functional text ('per ricordare').

2:compare-two-animals.why: Information and its relations (same / different) in informative texts; 'Leggere e confrontare informazioni provenienti da testi diversi' is the classe-quinta form.

3:cursive-sentences.why: Fluent corsivo: the manual abilities for writing (ITA.3.13).

3:word-fields.why: 'Comprendere le principali relazioni di significato tra le parole (somiglianze, differenze, appartenenza a un campo semantico)': the demand is met, though placed at the end of classe quinta.

3:person-words.why: Forno / fornaio, giardino / giardiniere: word families (ITA.3.17) and one mechanism of the 'parole ... derivate' (ITA.5.33).

3:root-words-in-context.why: The family of a word used to pick the right form for a sentence: 'famiglie di parole', 'Usare in modo appropriato le parole'; derivation is ITA.5.33.

K:human-body.why: Naming the parts of the body comes before 'prestare attenzione al funzionamento del proprio corpo'.

K:living-nonliving.why: Telling the living from the non-living prepares 'Riconoscere in altri organismi viventi ... bisogni analoghi ai propri' and is a classification by properties.

K:fruit-vegetable.why: A classification by properties; the plant view prepares 'i primi elementi di classificazione ... vegetale'. No objective names the parts of the plant.

K:animal-groups-homes.why: Animals 'in relazione con i loro ambienti' (SCI.3.11) and a first grouping of animals (SCI.5.12).

K:animal-babies.why: 'i momenti significativi nella vita di ... animali' and 'somiglianze e differenze nei percorsi di sviluppo'.

K:seasons.why: 'la periodicità dei fenomeni celesti (... stagioni)', the 'cicli temporali' of storia, and a tree through the year as a 'trasformazione ambientale naturale'.

K:weather-temperature.why: 'la variabilità dei fenomeni atmosferici (venti, nuvole, pioggia, ecc.)'; hot and cold things touch the everyday phenomena 'legati ... al calore'.

K:natural-made.why: Naturale / artificiale is a classification of objects 'in base alle loro proprietà'.

K:five-senses.why: The senses are the first look at 'il funzionamento del proprio corpo'.

K:recycling.why: Sorting waste classifies objects by material; GEO.3.7 speaks of 'gli interventi positivi e negativi dell'uomo ... esercitando la cittadinanza attiva'. In Italy this is mainly educazione civica, which the registry does not hold.

K:plant-needs.why: 'Riconoscere in altri organismi viventi ... bisogni analoghi ai propri' (water, light) and the life of plants observed in 'semine'.

K:sink-float.why: 'semplici fenomeni della vita quotidiana legati ai liquidi'; sorting floaters and sinkers is classifying by a property.

1:animal-classes-coverings.why: 'Elaborare i primi elementi di classificazione animale ...' is a classe-quinta objective; no classe-terza objective is about classifying animals (SCI.3.2 is about objects).

1:habitats-needs.why: 'Riconoscere in altri organismi viventi, in relazione con i loro ambienti, bisogni analoghi ai propri' (food, a home).

1:life-cycles.why: 'i momenti significativi nella vita di piante e animali ... percorsi di sviluppo di organismi animali e vegetali': the content is taught, the rearing and sowing the objective also asks is class work.

1:sink-float.why: 'Descrivere semplici fenomeni della vita quotidiana legati ai liquidi ... alle forze'; that heavy does not mean sinking leads to 'peso, peso specifico' of SCI.5.1.

1:body-parts.why: The objective is about how the body works ('funzionamento del proprio corpo'); naming its parts is the step before.

1:five-senses.why: Which sense and which organ for each experience is paying attention 'al funzionamento del proprio corpo (... freddo e caldo, ecc.)'.

1:weather.why: 'Avere familiarità con la variabilità dei fenomeni atmosferici'; the weekly forecast is a table of data to read.

1:materials-recycling.why: 'Seriare e classificare oggetti in base alle loro proprietà' (the material); tecnologia asks 'le proprietà dei materiali più comuni' by classe quinta.

1:plant-parts.why: No objective names the parts of a plant; knowing them and their jobs prepares observing 'la vita di piante' and seeing that plants have needs like ours.

1:sun-earth-moon.why: 'la periodicità dei fenomeni celesti' (the Moon's phases are one, though the list in brackets names only dì/notte, sun paths, seasons); 'il movimento dei diversi oggetti celesti' is SCI.5.8.

2:materials.why: 'Seriare e classificare oggetti in base alle loro proprietà'; materials are also a tecnologia topic (TEC.5.4).

2:plant-parts.why: As in classe prima: the wording of the classe-terza objectives does not name plant parts; this is the knowledge that observing plants and their needs builds on.

2:life-cycles.why: 'momenti significativi nella vita di ... animali' and their 'percorsi di sviluppo' (bruco-farfalla, girino-rana).

2:moon-phases.why: A periodic celestial phenomenon (SCI.3.8); the Moon's movement is interpreted in SCI.5.8.

2:day-and-night.why: SCI.3.8 asks only familiarity with 'dì/notte'; explaining it by the Earth's rotation goes beyond, toward 'Ricostruire e interpretare il movimento dei diversi oggetti celesti'.

2:habitats-adaptations.why: 'organismi viventi, in relazione con i loro ambienti'.

2:sink-float.why: A phenomenon 'legato ai liquidi ... alle forze'; shape and floating lead toward 'peso specifico ... pressione' of SCI.5.1.

3:water-cycle.why: 'trasformazioni ambientali naturali (ad opera del sole, di agenti atmosferici, dell'acqua ...)'; the changes of state and 'il ruolo [dell'acqua] nell'ambiente' are classe quinta.

3:flower-parts.why: No objective names the parts of the flower; they serve the 'momenti significativi nella vita di piante' (flowering, seed) and later plant classification.

3:life-cycles-compare.why: Exactly 'Individuare somiglianze e differenze nei percorsi di sviluppo di organismi animali'.

3:planets.why: The solar system is classe-quinta matter ('i diversi oggetti celesti'); SCI.3.8 covers only day, sun paths and seasons.

3:investigation.why: The phenomenon described is one 'legato ai liquidi' (SCI.3.4); recording the test prepares 'Rappresentare i dati dell'osservazione attraverso tabelle ... testi'. The method itself (ipotesi, prova, conclusione) is in the traguardi, not in the objectives.

K:birds-eye-view.why: 'Rappresentare in prospettiva verticale oggetti e ambienti noti'; matematica asks 'punti di vista diversi di uno stesso oggetto (dall'alto, di fronte, ecc.)' by classe quinta.

K:family.why: The family tree is the first frame for 'il proprio passato, della generazione degli adulti'; the family words widen vocabulary.

K:transport-flying.why: No objective on means of transport; the sheet is a classification of objects by a property (where they move).

K:wants-needs.none: Economic ideas (bisogni e desideri) have no objective in the disciplines of this registry; in Italy they fall under educazione civica.
K:wants-needs.why: Nothing in storia, geografia or scienze speaks of wants and needs of people; SCI.3.11 is about the needs of other living beings.

K:community-helpers.why: Only the tools part fits: matching a tool to its job is 'riconoscerne funzioni e modi d'uso'. The jobs themselves (i mestieri) have no objective here; they are educazione civica.

1:map-key.why: 'Leggere e interpretare la pianta dello spazio vicino': the key (legenda) and its symbols.

1:family-generations.why: Generations in order are 'relazioni di successione'; the tree is a 'semplice schema temporale'; my own tree prepares producing knowledge 'sul proprio passato, della generazione degli adulti'.

2:cardinal-directions.why: 'Orientarsi utilizzando la bussola e i punti cardinali' is a classe-quinta objective and asks real orientation; on paper it is prepared. Italian classes meet the punti cardinali in classe terza.

2:continents.why: 'i grandi caratteri dei diversi continenti e degli oceani' and mental maps extended 'ai diversi continenti' are classe quinta; classes 1-3 work on the near space only.

2:family-relationships.why: Zia, cugino, nonna from riddles: vocabulary widened through reading; kinship is the frame for the history of one's own family.

3:continents-oceans.why: Locating continents and oceans on the planisfero is the first step of GEO.5.5 (classe quinta), which asks their physical regions and main features too.

K:healthy-food.why: 'Avere cura della propria salute anche dal punto di vista alimentare' (classe quinta); SCI.3.4 names everyday phenomena 'legati ... al cibo'.

K:hygiene-habits.why: 'Avere cura della propria salute'; care of the body starts from attention to one's own body (SCI.3.10).

K:road-safety.none: Educazione stradale is not in the disciplines of this registry (in Italy: educazione civica, and the 'sicurezza' part of educazione fisica).
K:road-safety.why: No objective of PART 2 speaks of traffic or safety on the road.

1:food-groups.why: 'Avere cura della propria salute anche dal punto di vista alimentare'. Italian schools teach the piramide alimentare or five gruppi alimentari, not four groups.

1:healthy-habits.why: Daily hygiene habits prepare 'Avere cura della propria salute' (classe quinta).

1:road-signs.none: Educazione stradale is not in the disciplines of this registry (educazione civica in Italy).
1:road-signs.why: No objective of PART 2 names road signs or road behaviour.

2:healthy-habits-why.why: Why a habit protects the body links 'Avere cura della propria salute' with 'il funzionamento del proprio corpo'.

2:road-signs.none: Educazione stradale is not in the disciplines of this registry (educazione civica in Italy).
2:road-signs.why: No objective of PART 2 names road signs; sorting them by kind is not one of the classifications matematica means.

K:how-to-draw.why: Guided drawing prepares 'rappresentare e comunicare la realtà percepita'; tracing then drawing also trains the hand for writing.

1:how-to-draw.why: Arte e immagine has objectives only for the end of classe quinta: drawing by steps prepares 'rappresentare ... la realtà percepita' and is one of the 'tecniche ... per realizzare prodotti grafici'.

2:drawing.why: The drawing prepares ART.5.1; writing about it is a simple 'testo ... descrittivo'.

K:same-different-visual.none: Visual discrimination puzzle; no objective of PART 2 asks it.
K:same-different-visual.why: It is perceptual training; the only objective on perception (ITA.3.13) is about writing, and the sheet works on pictures, not letters.

K:mazes.none: Mazes: no objective fits (MAT.3.8 is about walking and describing a real route).
K:mazes.why: 'Eseguire un semplice percorso partendo dalla descrizione verbale o dal disegno' is a movement in physical space, not finding the way through a maze.

K:shadow-closure.none: Visual perception puzzle; no objective of PART 2 asks it.
K:shadow-closure.why: Matching a picture to its shadow is not recognising geometric figures and nothing else in the wording fits.

K:spot-the-difference.none: Visual comparison puzzle; no objective of PART 2 asks it.
K:spot-the-difference.why: No matematica wording (relazioni, classificare, regolarità) fits finding differences between two pictures.

K:matrix-logic.why: Each row holds one kind: the gap is filled by a classification 'in base a una ... proprietà' laid out in a grid.

K:grid-copy.why: 'Riprodurre in scala una figura assegnata (utilizzando, ad esempio, la carta a quadretti)': copying square by square is its 1:1 beginning.

1:find-the-differences.none: Visual discrimination puzzle; no objective of PART 2 asks it.
1:find-the-differences.why: Nothing in the matematica or italiano wording fits finding differences between pictures.

1:mazes.none: Mazes: no objective fits (MAT.3.8 is about real routes walked and described).
1:mazes.why: The percorsi of MAT.3.8 and GEO.3.2 are done in the space around the child.

1:grid-copy.why: Copying on squared paper prepares 'Riprodurre in scala una figura assegnata (... la carta a quadretti)'.

1:picture-analogies.none: Analogy puzzle; no objective of PART 2 asks it.
1:picture-analogies.why: The 'relazioni' of MAT.3.13 are relations and data shown in diagrams and tables, not analogies between pictures.

1:secret-code.none: Code puzzle; no objective of PART 2 asks it.
1:secret-code.why: Decoding with a key is neither reading a text nor one of the relations, classifications or regularities matematica names.

1:picture-sudoku.none: Sudoku: no objective of PART 2 asks it.
1:picture-sudoku.why: A logic puzzle with no counterpart in the wording.

1:logic-picture-clues.why: The grid is a double-entry table that represents a relation (who has what): 'Leggere e rappresentare relazioni e dati con diagrammi, schemi e tabelle'.

2:find-differences.why: Only the writing part fits: one complete sentence per difference ('Comunicare con frasi semplici e compiute'). The search itself has no objective.

2:logic-grid.why: A relation between two sets read and filled in a table from clues ('relazioni ... con ... tabelle').

3:two-attribute-sort.why: 'Classificare ... in base a una o più proprietà, utilizzando rappresentazioni opportune' (Venn, tabella a doppia entrata).

3:logic-grids.why: Relations represented and read in a table.

3:latin-square-sudoku.none: Sudoku: no objective of PART 2 asks it.
3:latin-square-sudoku.why: A logic puzzle with no counterpart in the wording.

K:feelings.none: Emotional education is not in the disciplines of this registry (infanzia: campo di esperienza 'Il sé e l'altro'; primaria: educazione civica).
K:feelings.why: The only wordings that name emotions are about making art (ART.5.1) or a diary (ITA.5.19), not about recognising feelings.

K:measurable-attributes.none: not yet read against this curriculum
K:measurable-attributes.why: The point was added on 2026-11-13 for a lesson of the US school year that the teacher leads without a page; no unit of this language teaches it. Read it against the wording before a lesson of this language stands on it.

2:estimate-lengths.none: not yet read against this curriculum
2:estimate-lengths.why: The point was added on 2026-11-13 for a lesson of the US school year that the teacher leads without a page; no unit of this language teaches it. Read it against the wording before a lesson of this language stands on it.

2:explain-strategies.none: not yet read against this curriculum
2:explain-strategies.why: The point was added on 2026-11-13 for a lesson of the US school year that the teacher leads without a page; no unit of this language teaches it. Read it against the wording before a lesson of this language stands on it.

K:read-picture-book.none: not yet read against this curriculum
K:read-picture-book.why: The point was added on 2026-11-13 for the English mini-books (Part 8); a language gets its own books, and no unit of this language teaches the point yet. Read it against the wording when the first books of this language are written.

K:read-decodable-text.none: not yet read against this curriculum
K:read-decodable-text.why: The point was added on 2026-11-13 for the English mini-books (Part 8); a language gets its own books, and no unit of this language teaches the point yet. Read it against the wording when the first books of this language are written.

2:chance-certain-possible.why: The objective of classes 4 and 5 is «di una coppia di eventi intuire … qual è il più probabile»; calling a draw certain, possible or impossible prepares it.

3:chance-more-likely.why: Two bags, one piece: which is more likely, or are they «ugualmente probabili»? The objective stands in classes 4 and 5.
